metadataDescription: A fast, intelligent, and versatile online judge for problem solving, training, and programming contests.

hero.title: Move every line of code <speed>faster toward the answer</speed>, and <smart>learn smarter</smart>
hero.description: On {siteName}, everything from writing and submitting to understanding feedback feels seamless. Focus on solving; leave the waiting and uncertainty to the platform.

speed.title: A seamless path from submit to insight
speed.description: See every stage clearly, confirm results sooner, locate issues, and move straight into your next attempt.

submit.title: Submit with confidence
submit.description: Finish your code and let the platform carry the judging flow forward.

evaluate.title: Transparent evaluation
evaluate.description: Compilation, test execution, and results stay visible at every stage.

feedback.title: Iterate quickly
feedback.description: Use detailed records and feedback to return to your code with direction.

ai.title: Go beyond the verdict and understand the problem
ai.description: Intelligence is woven into the solving flow, turning every setback into a clearer next step.
ai.locateDescription: Find useful signals in code behavior and judge feedback to shorten debugging.
ai.summarizeDescription: Distill important ideas from each solution so they are easier to retain and revisit.
ai.generateDescription: Get intelligent support while preparing and validating problems across more meaningful cases.
ai.learnDescription: Bring problems, submissions, and feedback together into one continuous learning journey.

features.title: Practice, train, and compete in one place
features.description: From everyday problem solving to serious contests, keep one familiar experience across every goal.

problems.title: Problem library
problems.description: Browse, filter, and solve problems to build strong skills through consistent practice.

training.title: Focused training
training.description: Organize practice around key topics so every session has a clear direction.

contests.title: Online contests
contests.description: Challenge yourself at real contest pace, then improve through rankings and review.

homework.title: Course homework
homework.description: See assignments, progress, and outcomes together in one clear view.

ranking.title: Rankings and records
ranking.description: Review submissions and progress, using visible growth to stay motivated.

community.title: Discussion and ideas
community.description: Share approaches and read solutions to discover new ways to think.

device.title: A continuous experience from desktop to mobile
device.description: Focus on coding at your desk or check problems and results on the go. The information that matters is always within reach.

cta.title: Your next Accepted starts here
cta.description: Log in to sync progress, submissions, and your profile, then keep moving through every challenge.

footer: © {siteName} · Built for people who love code
